thesis: The episode introduces the Capital Allocators podcast, which explores investment opportunities through conversations with money managers conducted by institutional clients. It features an interview between Stephen Gilmore of New Zealand Superfund and Greg Jensen of Bridgewater Associates, discussing Bridgewater's investment logic, its two main arms (discretionary trading and risk parity), and its focus on client support and research.
